content: We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the carbonyl-ene reaction retrosynthetically. The forward reaction: alkene + carbonyl -> new C-C bond, C=C becomes C-C, C=O becomes C-O, forming hydroxyl and a five-membered ring. So retrosynthesis: break C-O bond (hydroxyl) to carbonyl, break C-C bond to alkene, forming a carbonyl and an alkene within same molecule (intramolecular). The template likely is something like "C=O + C=C -> C-O + C-C (ring closure)". We need to search templates that match this transformation. The search tool didn't return any. Maybe need to search without too many criteria. Let's just search for templates that involve breaking a ketone and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five-membered ring. Use functional_groups_broken ["ketones"], functional_groups_formed ["aliphatic hydroxyls","five-membered rings"].
